title: Recapture CA-only PottsMPNN checkpoints as ProteinMPNN-style weights
description: v_48_002/010/020 from KeatingLab/PottsMPNN have no etab_out layer — they are CA-only ProteinMPNN models (W_out → 21-dim per-site logits, not pairwise Potts couplings). Recapture W_e + encoder_layers + W_out using a ProteinMPNN-style recapture path and store as model_params/pottsmpnn_ca_002/010/020.eqx.zst. Expose through the existing aminx ProteinMPNN inference path with ca_only=True. These are distinct from the Dauparas ProteinMPNN weights (different training data/objective, Keating lab provenance).

title: ThermoMPNN Potts: recapture and integrate as aminx.potts composed variant
description: ThermoMPNN (Dieckhaus et al.) is trained with thermostability data; a Potts variant would provide stability-aware pairwise couplings. Locate checkpoint source (likely published alongside the ThermoMPNN paper or Keating lab repo), verify it has an etab_out layer, add to the recapture manifest, and expose as a named variant (e.g. pottsmpnn_thermo) in the aminx.potts model registry.

title: Yehlin Cho stability-trained MPNN: recapture and integrate as aminx.potts composed variant
description: Cho et al. MPNN trained with experimental stability data. Locate checkpoint source, verify Potts-compatible architecture (etab_out present), add to recapture manifest alongside the existing PottsMPNN variants. Expose as a named variant in the aminx.potts model registry. May require a separate recapture script if the architecture diverges from KeatingLab/PottsMPNN.

title: Refactor aminx to use xtrax as a dependency
description: Add xtrax as a direct aminx dependency and migrate internal JAX utility code (training loops, optimiser wrappers, scan patterns, device mesh helpers) to use xtrax equivalents. Audit current aminx.training and aminx.host for overlap with xtrax API surface; prefer xtrax over bespoke implementations. Update pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and any affected import paths.
